queries.queryString:
db_system=cassandra db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceCategory = Labs/cassandra*  "InetAddress" "is now UP"| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as mesg
| parse regex field=mesg "(?<level>[A-Z]*) *\[(?<thread_name>[^\]]*?)[:_-]?(?<thread_id>[0-9]*)\] (?<Date>.{10} .{12}) *(?<source_file>[^:]*):(?<source_line>[0-9]*) - (?<message>.*)"
| parse regex field=message "InetAddress /(?<endpoint>[^ ]*) is now UP"
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status | withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by endpoint
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields endpoint, event_time, remark
